facts: NASA SP-8119 recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting dissimilar metals that will touch.
The recommendation to consult the electrochemical series is intended to address electrochemical (galvanic) corrosion between contacting parts.
payload.query: What does NASA SP-8119 recommend consulting when selecting dissimilar metals for parts that touch, and what risk is this intended to address?
payload.answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting dissimilar metals that will touch. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- The recommendation to consult the electrochemical series is intended to address electrochemical (galvanic) corrosion between contacting parts. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
